name: Billion Context
description: Context compression for the agent loop: the model decides what to compact instead of a hard cut, so a small window stays usable and a long session spends a fraction of the tokens. Ships the upstream pi extension (billion-context 0.1.215) unchanged.
author: ranxianglei

zh-CN.name: Billion Context 上下文压缩
zh-CN.description: 上下文压缩：由模型决定压什么，而不是硬截断，小窗口够用、长会话 token 大幅下降。内置上游 pi 扩展（billion-context 0.1.215），内容未改动。
